lines.say: Your air plan just got downgraded to basic.
Basic air means two deep breaths an hour. The rest is shallow.
Your windows lock. Outside air is a premium feature.
Premium costs sixty dollars a month. You pay. Your balance hits zero.
Then you see who gets the best plan in the tower. Not people. The lobby plants. They're worth more.
Would you pay for premium air? Write it in the comments.
